title: Construction Cutoffs, File Status and Closing Credit on Design Studio Selections Files
content:
Structural selections close when construction starts on the purchase agreement, and every selection is final when the home reaches drywall; these status changes follow the construction record and are not made on request. A file is opened only for a purchase agreement that is ratified and not an inventory home. At closing every option deposit held is credited against the amount due where the package credits deposits at closing, one entry per source payment.

**Status of a Design Studio Selections file through construction**

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Awaiting appointment | The file is open; no design appointment has yet been held |
| In selection | The first design appointment has been held and selections are open |
| Structural closed | Construction has started on the homesite; structural options can no longer be changed. A file still awaiting appointment when construction starts closes its structural selections at the included standard |
| Finalized | The home has reached drywall; every selection is final |
| Delivered | The home has closed with the selected options installed |
| Cancelled | The purchase agreement was cancelled or terminated |

**Points of judgement**

- *Whose record decides the cutoffs?* The construction record of the purchase agreement. A buyer's request does not move a file into or out of structural closed or finalized.
- *Who may have a file opened?* The buyer under a ratified purchase agreement that is not an inventory home.
- *How is the closing credit entered?* One closing credit entry per option deposit payment held, each carrying that payment's receipt number, dated on the closing date.
